author: Sheryl Tian Tong Lee (News)
description: Singapore’s government is supportive of moves to formally enshrine its Leader of the Opposition role, The Straits Times reported Tuesday.
title: Singapore Supports Move To Enshrine Opposition Leader Role, Straits Times Reports

description: Renaissance Macro Research Head of Economic Research Neil Dutta joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss his call that Federal Reserve Chairman nominee Kevin Warsh faces several uphill battles before his confirmation proceedings even begin. Dutta explains his findings that Warsh "has been hawkish throughout his entire public career, up until about the six months during which he's been interviewing for the Fed job," and also discusses how the Fed "being bigger than one person" could limit market anxiety. Dutta also says the gridlock around Senator Thom Tillis delaying any Fed confirmation could create more complications for Warsh. Dutta speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh's Nomination Was the Easy Part: RenMac's Dutta

description: Senator Ted Budd (R) North Carolina states 'Iran is always testing us," when discussing the US shooting down an Iranian drone headed towards a US Navy ship. He talks about what possible diplomatic solutions could be negotiated between the US & Iran, his reaction to the House passing a two week continuing resolution to keep the government open, and shares his thoughts on President Trump suggesting the GOP should federalize state voting rules. Senator Budd speaks with Joe Mathieu and Julie Fine on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Always Testing Us: Sen. Budd on US Shot Down Iranian Drone

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran has stepped down from his post leading the White House’s Council of Economic Advisers, according to a Trump administration official.
title: Fed Governor Miran Steps Down From White House CEA Role

description: Wall Street has been skeptical about software stocks for a while, but sentiment has gone from bearish to doomsday lately with traders dumping shares of companies across the industry as fears about the destruction to be wrought by artificial intelligence pile up. The anxiety was underscored Tuesday after AI startup Anthropic released a productivity tool for in-house lawyers, sending shares of legal software and publishing firms tumbling. “We call it the ‘SaaSpocalypse,’ an apocalypse for software-as-a-service stocks,” said Jeffrey Favuzza, who works on the equity trading desk at Jefferies. “Trading is very much ‘get me out’ style selling.” Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Global Head of Technology Research Mandeep Singh joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. He speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Traders Dump Software Stocks as AI Fears Erupt

description: The partial US government shutdown ended after President Donald Trump signed a funding deal he negotiated with Senate Democrats. Trump speaks to the reporters in the Oval Office.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Signs Deal to Fully Reopen Government

author: Joe Mayes
description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer and President Donald Trump discussed the joint UK-US military base on Diego Garcia, a point of contention between the two countries after the president reversed his previous support for a plan to return sovereignty of the island to Mauritius.
title: Starmer, Trump Discuss UK Base Deal Panned by White House

description: The partial US government shutdown ended late Tuesday after President Donald Trump signed into law a funding deal he negotiated with Senate Democrats, overcoming opposition from both ends of the political spectrum amid a standoff over his administration’s immigration crackdown. Erik Wasson reports on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Signs Funding Package Ending Partial Government Shutdown

author: Oscar Medina, Kate Sullivan
description: President Donald Trump discussed counternarcotics efforts with Colombian leader counterpart Gustavo Petro on Tuesday and described the meeting with his onetime foe as productive.
title: Trump Sees Joint Anti-Drugs Efforts in Thaw With Colombia

author: K Oanh Ha, Yang Yang (News), Naomi Ng
description: As a national election looms, the country's chaotic marijuana industry is at a crossroads
title: Thailand’s Cannabis Experiment Faces Moment of Truth at Polls

description: Advanced Micro Devices met average earnings estimates but disappointed investors with a discouraging forecast around AI inroads and innovation as it fights for market share with Nvidia. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: AMD Outlook Disappoints Investors Seeking Bigger AI Payoff

author: Alicia Diaz
description: The US renewed a trade preference program with African nations for one year though the step has little immediate impact because of global tariffs President Donald Trump imposed.
title: US Renews Africa Trade Program Though Trump Tariffs Remain

description: Thailand decriminalized cannabis in 2022, but a push to roll back the experiment is gaining steam. On today’s Big Take Asia: how the industry lost its way and what this weekend’s elections mean for its uncertain future. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Thailand's Push To Recriminalize Weed

author: Liam Knox
description: The school may be less inclined to cut a deal that can be revoked later.
title: Why Harvard is Well-Positioned to Weather Trump’s Latest Attack

author: Jim Wyss
description: The beefed up US military presence in the Caribbean, designed to crack down on drug routes and turn the screws on Venezuela and Cuba, is set to deliver economic gains for Puerto Rico.
title: US Military Build Up Seen Giving Puerto Rico $833 Million Bump

author: Erica Yokoyama, Akemi Terukina
description: From viral handbags to selfies with world leaders, Sanae Takaichi's social savvy is paying off with the youth. That popularity will be put to the test in Japan’s upcoming lower-house election.
title: How Japan’s First Female Leader Won Over Disillusioned Young Voters

author: Alex Harris
description: Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Federal Reserve, has been vocal about his desire to shrink the central bank’s balance sheet. To do so will require a more “interventionist” Fed when it comes to day-to-day money market operations, according to Mizhuo Securities USA LLC.
title: Smaller Fed Balance Sheet Requires More Active Fed, Mizuho Says

description: Senator John Cornyn, a Republican from Texas, discusses the latest on the partial government shutdown and shares thoughts on ICE and DHS funding stating local governments need to work with the federal government. Senator Cornyn speaks with Joe Mathieu and Julie Fine on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senator Cornyn on ICE, DHS Funding and Government Shutdown

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss software stocks seeing pressure as AI seems to upend the sector. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence joins the show to discuss. Then, Bloomberg's Patrick Clark weighs in on a report that homebuilders are proposing 'Trump Homes' to address the affordability crisis. Also, Bloomberg News Capital Influence Team Leader Megan Scully joins to discuss the House passing a funding package to end the partial government shutdown. Then, Bloomberg News Entertainment Team Leader Chris Palmeri weighs in on Disney's move to pick parks Chief Josh D’Amaro as CEO Bob Iger's successor. Finally, BlackRock Head of Retirement Jaime Magyera joins to discuss women's wealth and retirement patterns. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: House Approves Trump Funding Deal | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 2/03/2026

author: Leah Nylen, Josh Sisco
description: The US Justice Department and a group of states will appeal a federal judge’s ruling that imposed only modest limits on Alphabet Inc.’s Google contracts related to its search engine and artificial intelligence apps.
title: Google Search Ruling to be Appealed by DOJ, States

description: White House-led negotiations over crypto market-structure legislation will continue after Monday’s meeting ended with no agreement on how to handle the contentious issue of stablecoin yield. The former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger, who is now CEO of Blockchain Association, was at the White House meeting yesterday. She talks about the Crypto Market Structure Bill progress and says it should be done by midterms. Mersinger joined the conversation on "Bloomeberg Crypto" with Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Structure Bill Should Be Done By Midterms: Mersinger

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Joe Mathieu discusses the partial government shutdown vote in the House of Representatives. On today's show, Republican Congresswoman Erin Houchin, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and Obama 2012 Campaign Manager Jim Messina. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Partial Shutdown On Track to End | Balance of Power: Early Edition 2/03/2026

description: Jim Messina, Democratic strategist and campaign manager for Obama's 2012 reelection campaign said that his party should not lean into the mantra of 'abolish ICE' in the 2026 midterm elections and should instead promote 'common sense reform' that is backed by the American people who don't like what they see from ICE agents in Minneapolis. Messina said that Democrats have to focus on affordability and take advantage of President Trump's falling poll numbers on the economy to succeed in the midterms. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Abolish ICE Should Not Be Democrat's Midterm Message, Says Jim Messina

description: On today’s Big Take, host David Gura is joined by Bloomberg investigative reporter and podcast host Jason Leopold to discuss what was and wasn’t in the latest document release — and what we’ve learned about Epstein and his business connections.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: What Is And Isn't In The Latest Epstein Files Release

description: Republican Representative Erin Houchin said Republicans and Democrats are still working though differences over whether there should be restrictions on Immigration and Customs Enforcement, but there needs to be a cooling of the rhetoric around ICE's work. The Indiana congresswoman said that she does not believe that a two week stopgap is enough time for the necessary negotiations around funding the Department of Homeland Security, but that she believes her party will get the job done. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Lawmakers 'Working Through' Tensions Around ICE Funding

author: Liam Knox
description: After a months-long lull in the White House’s battle with Harvard University, President Donald Trump has thrust the school back into the spotlight and dramatically ratcheted up the financial stakes of their showdown.
title: Trump’s $1 Billion Demand Resets Stakes of Harvard Talks

description: Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos is set to face questions from a Senate subcommittee about its planned purchase of Warner Bros.' streaming and studio businesses. Jennifer Huddleston, senior fellow in technology policy at the Cato Institute, says Netflix is likely to focus on “market definition" to deflect antitrust concerns. She joins Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Netflix CEO Faces Lawmakers' Antitrust Scrutiny

description: A criminal investigation has been launched into allegations Lord Peter Mandelson passed market-sensitive information to paedophile financier Jeffrey Epstein, the Press Association understands.
title: Mandelson to Face Criminal Investigation Amid Epstein Scandal, PA Reports

author: Jamie Tarabay
description: Former President Bill Clinton and his wife, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, will appear before a House committee investigating their ties to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein on Feb. 26 and 27, the panel confirmed Tuesday.
title: Clintons to Testify to House Panel Over Epstein Ties This Month

author: Michael J Kavanagh
description: Peter Mandelson tried to involve Jeffrey Epstein in a deal to create a private bank to manage the Republic of Congo’s oil funds, documents released by the US Department of Justice show.
title: Epstein Files Show Mandelson Pushed Republic of Congo Bank Deal

author: Anthony Capaccio, Mia Gindis
description: The US Navy shot down an Iranian drone headed toward a US aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea, spooking oil markets amid heightened tensions between Washington and Tehran.
title: US Jet Shoots Down Iranian Drone Near Carrier in Arabian Sea

author: Erik Wasson, Alicia Diaz, Caitlin Reilly, Emily Birnbaum
description: The ongoing partial US government shutdown is nearing an end after President Donald Trump pressured conservative hardliners to drop a blockade against a deal he negotiated with Senate Democrats.
title: US Shutdown Nears End as House Advances Trump Funding Deal

author: Lucy White
description: Nigel Farage said he plans to cut taxes on beer and the hospitality sector by reinstating a cap on child benefits if his Reform UK party wins the next general election.
title: Farage Pledges Tax Breaks for Pubs With Cuts to Child Benefits

author: Ken Parks
description: China and Uruguay pledged to deepen their economic relationship Tuesday as Javier Milei next door in Argentina is welcoming the Trump administration’s renewed doctrine in the region.
title: China Courts Uruguay as Argentina’s Milei Embraces Trump

description: The Canadian government says it is working with the US Federal Aviation Administration, General Dynamics Corp. and Bombardier Inc. to address certification issues for some of Gulfstream’s private jet models after a complaint made by President Donald Trump.
title: Canada Seeks to Resolve Gulfstream Dispute After Trump Threat

author: Jen Judson
description: The Seattle-based defense firm Overland AI Inc. has raised $100 million in new funding to help accelerate the use of robots and other autonomous systems across the US military’s ground forces.
title: Overland AI Raises $100 Million to Speed Up Use of Military Land Robots

description: A controversial far-right politician has left Giorgia Meloni’s governing coalition, creating a fracture in Matteo Salvini’s League party.
title: Italy’s Far-Right Lawmaker Leaves Meloni’s Coalition

author: Patricia Garip, Eric Martin, Esteban Duarte
description: The US government is preparing to issue a general license allowing companies to pump oil in Venezuela, part of the Trump administration’s plan to ease sanctions and rebuild the nation’s moribund energy industry.
title: US Plans to Issue License for Companies to Pump Venezuelan Oil

author: Sam Dagher, Khalid Al Ansary
description: A standoff between the White House and Iraqi politicians over who should be the Arab country’s next prime minister is worsening, according to several people, with the rift threatening to destabilize the OPEC member.
title: US Rachets Up Pressure on Iraq Over Post of Prime Minister

author: Julian Lee
description: China resumed its position as the biggest importer of Russian seaborne crude in January
title: Russia’s Crude Shipments Hold Steady While Flows to India Slump

author: Alberto Nardelli, Jenny Leonard
description: The European Union will pitch the US on a critical minerals partnership to curb China’s influence, looking to shape the Trump administration’s push to strike global agreements this week.
title: EU to Offer US Critical Minerals Partnership to Check China

author: Alex Wickham
description: The UK government has referred communications between former cabinet minister Peter Mandelson and Jeffrey Epstein to the police after it found them to contain market-sensitive information.
title: Mandelson Resigns After UK Refers Epstein Emails to Police

description: Analilia Mejia, a longtime labor activist who’s never held elected office, is one of close to a dozen Democrats who are vying for an open Congressional seat in New Jersey.
title: A Mamdani-Style Candidate Looks to Win Over New Jersey’s Suburbs

author: Alex Longley
description: A vessel was hailed by smaller armed ships in the Strait of Hormuz, a UK naval group said, with heightened focus on the vital waterway amid tensions between the US and Iran.
title: UK Navy Says Ship Hailed by Armed Small Vessels in Hormuz

description: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said the Group of 7 should work toward shared tools for tackling global economic imbalances including China’s vast trade surpluses with the rest of the world.
title: France Eyes Shared Tools at G-7 to Address Economic Imbalances

author: Dinesh Nair, Zainab Fattah, Alex Dooler
description: Donald Trump’s whirlwind tour of the Middle East last year included breakfast with Sheikh Khaled bin Mohammed, Abu Dhabi’s crown prince. The US president was seeking billions of dollars in investment, and the Emirati royal is now in pole position to deliver.
title: Abu Dhabi Builds a New Deal Machine Around its Crown Prince

author: Hugo Miller
description: An investigation into ties between Credit Suisse and Nazi Germany has so far revealed hundreds of accounts with potential links to Nazi-era officials and industrialists, including the SS paramilitary wing, according to US Senator Charles Grassley, adding to pressure on the bank ahead of a key hearing.
title: Credit Suisse Nazi Probe Reveals Fresh SS Links, Says Senator

description: MBS is shifting strategy in a way that suggests normalization of ties is unlikely anytime soon.

description: The German government will buy a 25.1% stake in the German unit of power grid operator Tennet Holding BV after years of wrangling between Berlin and The Hague.
title: Berlin Buys 25% Stake in Tennet’s German Grid for €3.3 Billion

description: Ethiopia will return to double-digit economic growth this fiscal year after reforms backed by the International Monetary Fund eased foreign exchange constraints and strengthened exports.
title: Ethiopia Returns to Double-Digit Economic Growth After Reforms

description: Turkey plans to host high-level talks between the US and Iran on Friday aimed at de-escalating tensions between the two countries.
title: Turkey Is Preparing to Host US-Iran Talks in Istanbul

description: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said Spain would block children from using social media platforms including Instagram and TikTok in a new European push to regulate digital platforms.
title: Spain to Ban Children From Social Platforms Like Grok and TikTok

description: Russia and Myanmar strengthened military ties this week, as President Vladimir Putin’s top security aide visited the Southeast Asian nation after the ruling junta concluded an election that Western democracies and the United Nations have described as flawed.
title: Putin’s Top Security Aide Deepens Ties With Myanmar After Vote

author: S'thembile Cele
description: The leader of South Africa’s second-biggest political party plans to step down from the position when it holds internal elections in two months’ time.
title: South Africa’s Steenhuisen to Quit as Democratic Alliance Leader

description: India expects revenue collections to be buoyant in the year beginning April, potentially allowing it to scale back its borrowing program, according to a senior finance ministry official.
title: India Sees Strong Revenue, Scope to Trim Borrowing Next Year

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia.

On today's show, Indian shares and the rupee rallied after the US reduced tariffs on Indian goods to 18%. President Trump says the US will reduce the tariffs after Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi agreed to stop buying Russian oil.

Bloomberg understands that Elon Musk is merging SpaceX with xAI in an all-stock deal valuing the new company at $1.25 trillion, bringing together two of the largest closely held companies in the world. SpaceX is still planning to do an IPO later this year.

Bill and Hillary Clinton agreed to testify in the congressional investigation into Jeffrey Epstein, averting a potential criminal contempt vote.

Today's guests: Bank of America UK economist Sonali Punhani & BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Cuts India Tariffs in Russian Oil Deal & Musk's SpaceX-xAI Combine | Daybreak Europe 2/3/2026

author: Hallie Gu, Eko Listiyorini
description: US soybean oil futures climbed on Tuesday after President Donald Trump unexpectedly announced a trade deal with India, in a sign of optimism that a truce could open the way for billions of dollars of American products to hit the world’s most populous nation.
title: Soy Oil Market Shows First Sign of Optimism on US Trade to India

description: France’s parliament adopted a budget for 2026 after Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu survived two no-confidence votes Monday. The new budget has smaller spending cuts and tax increases than earlier proposals, meaning the deficit for the year, expected at 5%, will be larger than initially planned. Bloomberg’s Caroline Connan reports.
title: France Adopts Budget as PM Survives No-Confidence Votes

description: US President Donald Trump said he anticipated talks with Iran over a new nuclear deal in the coming days. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian ordered the start of negotiations with Washington “within the framework of the nuclear issue,” Iran’s semi-official Fars news service reported. Iran’s priority in new talks will be sanctions relief and Tehran is “realistic” in its approach, a spokesman for Iran’s foreign ministry said. Bloomberg’s Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports.
title: Trump Eyes Iran Nuclear Deal With Talks Planned

author: Olesia Safronova
description: Ukraine faced the biggest Russian missile and drone attack so far this year after the Kremlin ended a brief moratorium on strikes against energy infrastructure sought by US President Donald Trump ahead of peace talks.
title: Ukraine Faces Energy Attacks as Russia Ends Pause on Strikes

author: Rakesh Sharma, Serene Cheong
description: Indian refiners are seeking guidance from New Delhi on the future of Russian purchases after President Donald Trump announced the world’s third-largest oil importer would stop taking Moscow’s crude in exchange for lower trade tariffs.
title: India’s Refiners Seek Clarity on Russian Oil After Trump Deal

author: Andras Gergely, Selcuk Gokoluk, Marton Kasnyik
description: Investors are stepping up bold wagers on Hungary’s stocks, bonds and currency ahead of elections that could redefine the country’s future.
title: Bold Hungary Bet Lures Investors as Pivotal Election Nears

author: Shruti Srivastava, Dan Strumpf, Swati Gupta
description: President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi took a major step to reset fractured ties with a surprise deal on Monday to slash tariffs, bringing much-needed relief to India’s economy.
title: Trump’s Surprise Trade Deal With India Resets Fractured Ties

author: John Harney
description: President Donald Trump said “we are now seeking one billion dollars in damages” from Harvard University after the New York Times reported that his administration had backed off on demands for $200 million to satisfy accusations of wrongdoing by the Ivy League institution.
title: Trump Says He’s Seeking $1 Billion From Harvard University

author: Jacob Reid
description: The architect of Brexit has long struggled in a place that voted to remain in the EU. But his Reform UK party is gaining traction.
title: Farage Sets Sights on Election Upset in Brexit-Skeptical Scotland

author: John Harney
description: National Intelligence Director Tulsi Gabbard rebuked Democratic lawmakers and others who expressed alarm over her participation in an FBI raid of a Georgia county election office, saying that President Donald Trump had asked her to be there.
title: Gabbard Scorns Critics of Her Role in FBI Election Office Raid

author: Yian Lee
description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te called on opposition lawmakers to move ahead with plans to spend extra money on the military, underscoring his campaign to bolster the democracy’s defenses as China ramps up its intimidation.
title: Taiwan’s Lai Calls Delays to Special Defense Budget ‘Dangerous’

author: Patpicha Tanakasempipat, Philip Heijmans
description: Bangkok’s royalist establishment is looking to Newin Chidchob to help fend off pro-democracy reformers and form a government in the Feb. 8 election.
title: Power in Thailand Now Runs Through a Soccer-Mad Rural Strongman

description: Pakistan says it has fielded requests for its JF-17 fighter from five countries in recent months — a surge of interest that could overwhelm its capacity to jointly produce the jet with China.
title: Pakistan Faces Crunch as Demand for China-Developed Jets Surges

author: Erica Yokoyama, Takashi Umekawa
description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi wasn’t overly highlighting the benefits of a weak yen at the weekend, in a move that suggested she was trying to preserve speculation over government intervention risks.
title: Japan’s Katayama Says Takaichi Wasn’t Emphasizing Weak Yen Merit

description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Madeleine Dean (D) PA states it's "a message too late" when discussing whether or not DHS Secretary Kristi Noem's decision to deploy body cameras to ICE agents in Minneapolis will influence her vote to reopen the government. Rep. Beth Van Duyne (R) TX shares her reaction to the special election in Texas, and Texas State Senator-Elect Taylor Rehmet (D) on how he flipped a GOP state senate seat. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: ICE Raids Fight Complicates House Vote | Balance of Power: Late Edition 02/02/2026

author: Charles Gorrivan, Riley Griffin, Robert Langreth
description: The US health department’s inspector general is investigating whether a top US Food and Drug Administration official misled the federal government by using a sham divorce to avoid running afoul of conflict-of-interest rules, people familiar with the investigation said.
title: Senior FDA Official Under OIG Investigation Over Divorce, Assets

author: Andreina Itriago, Fabiola Zerpa
description: Venezuela acting President Delcy Rodríguez appointed longtime ally Félix Plasencia as her representative in the US.
title: Venezuela Names Félix Plasencia as US Representative

author: Jamie Tarabay, Erik Wasson, Steven T. Dennis
description: Former President Bill Clinton and his wife, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, will appear before a congressional committee investigating the disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein, their lawyers said Monday.
title: Clintons Back Down, Agree to Testify in House Epstein Inquiry

description: The US decision to sharply reduce tariffs on Indian goods should strengthen the rupee and boost Indian stocks, strategists and fund managers said.
title: India’s Rupee, Stocks to Get Tariff-Truce Boost, Investors Say
